instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/ring.step and /home/user/Desktop/tab.step in BRL-CAD. Attach the 35 x 20 x 10 mm rectangular tab to the outside +X side of the ring, aligned with the ring center in Y and Z and extending outward along X. Fuse the tab and ring, then cut one through hole of diameter 8 mm at the center of the tab free end. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl. [Software] Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). At the start of the task, BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `ring.step`.
